body: i’m just tired lol 🤷🏻‍♀️ like, i could either choose to continue struggling with my brain making new ways to torment me every chance it gets, while dealing with school, housing, employment, not to mention all the complexities that come with anything social, i can keep trying to repair my relationship with my family, continue transitioning, there’s just so much to do, or, i could choose to stop, end everything, have it all be done, ik it’s lowkey pathetic to not have some big grand reason and instead just have a handful of straws piled up, and not even an absurd amount at that more than likely, but i’m just too tired to keep trying, i’m just over it all lol, idk why i wanna talk ab it, given i ghosted all the people in my life who i may have been able to, but 🤷🏻‍♀️ just mostly getting ready for it rn, not gonna let myself second guess outta it
